title: Navy Public Affairs and Visual Information Support
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > NAVSUP > NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT > NAVSUP FLC NORFOLK > NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR NORFOLK
description:
The Contractor shall provide comprehensive management, administrative, and technical support services to Navy Public Affairs and Visual Information (PA/VI) units. Support services shall be provided across four core functional domains: 

 Equipment, Inventory, and Logistics Management 

 Operations Support 

 Training and Readiness 

 Executive-Level Administrative Support Services
